description_en: Queries the elastic scaling history of an instance
description_zh: 调用DescribeAutoScalingHistory接口，查询实例弹性伸缩历史信息
name: DescribeAutoScalingHistory

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

Currently, only ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances are supported
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

当前仅支持RDS MySQL实例
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The type of elastic scaling task to query. Currently, only SPEC is supported, which indicates querying the automatic performance scaling history
parameters.help_zh: 查询的弹性伸缩业务种类。当前仅支持SPEC，表示仅支持查询自动性能扩展历史信息
parameters.name: auto_scaling_task_type

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the query task. Specify the value as a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

The start time cannot be earlier than 45 days before the current time
parameters.help_zh:
查询任务的开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒。

查询任务的开始时间最大不能早于当前时间45天
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the query task. Specify the value as a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.
The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
查询任务结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒。
查询任务结束时间需晚于查询任务开始时间
parameters.name: end_time
